interpretation_limits: An unresolved interval does not establish invariance or equivalence.
Unavailability and method failure are not scientific nulls.
No outcome demonstrates practical data-selection utility or supplies missing attribution comparisons.
Far-minus-near contrasts test replacement-policy dependence, not lexical distance as a sole cause.

family.adjustment: Bonferroni: each two-sided percentile interval at 1 - alpha/5 (0.99)
family.endpoint_seed_rule: stable_seed(root_seed, endpoint_id): SHA-256 of the pipe-joined decimal/string parts, first 8 bytes big-endian, modulo 2**31-1 (original helper).
family.law: Python random.Random(endpoint_seed); per replicate draw 24 block indices with replacement by 24 successive randrange(24) calls over the sorted block order; statistic = equal-weight mean of the drawn block values; fixed backgrounds, seeds and focals are retained inside blocks.
family.name: E01_far_control_primary_family
family.percentile: Linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p with p = (1-confidence)/2 and 1-(1-confidence)/2.
